hypothesis: A single depth-limited gradient-boosting classifier using ten frozen OHLCV/time features can predict next-bar direction with positive net expectancy after a fixed 1.5-pip round-trip cost and outperform every preregistered directional baseline on untouched chronological test folds.

dataset.rule: Abort with INSUFFICIENT_DATA if SHA-256, row count, or time range differs. Do not silently update this registration.

feature_boundary: Exactly ten frozen features, computed only from bars closed before the forecast target. No MACD, RSI, EMA crossover, cross-asset data, news features, order-flow imbalance, or spread feature. The pinned OHLCV dataset does not establish availability of those external/microstructure fields; they are not imputed or fabricated.
target: Direction of the next contiguous five-minute close-to-close return. Skip any sample crossing a missing/non-five-minute bar. Features are available only from bars closed before target formation.

validation.purge_embargo: At least 30 minutes between train and test boundaries; no training label interval may overlap test labels.
validation.purged_kfold: Run a purged chronological fold audit with a 30-minute embargo as a leakage diagnostic; do not use its scores to tune the model.

success_criteria: At least 3 untouched chronological test folds
Aggregate trade hit-rate after costs greater than 0.53
Positive mean net return after 1.5-pip cost with 95% block-bootstrap lower confidence bound above zero
Net Sharpe after costs greater than 0.5
No more than 10 signals per UTC day
Model beats each directional baseline on aggregate net return and hit-rate
kill_criteria: After 3 test folds, aggregate trade hit-rate at or below 0.51
More than 10 signals per UTC day
Any feature/threshold/model change after seeing test results

verdict_rules.EDGE_CONFIRMED: All success criteria pass and no kill criterion is triggered.
verdict_rules.EDGE_REJECTED: At least 3 valid folds exist and a performance kill criterion is triggered.
verdict_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Pinned data is unavailable/mismatched, fewer than 3 valid folds exist, required fields are absent, or evaluation cannot be completed without changing this registration.

integrity_rule: This file must be committed before implementation. Any change after observing evaluation outcomes invalidates this experiment.
